name: Santorini & Cyclades
about: Peak Jul–Aug is hot, crowded and pricey. Many hotels/restaurants close entirely Nov–Mar — check availability, not just weather.
overview: Whitewashed villages perched on a volcanic caldera, built for sunset views and slow, expensive dinners.
costOverview: Step away from the caldera and prices are ordinary; anything with a sunset view carries a steep premium.
monthlyWeather: cool and rainy, the wettest and coldest month of the year
